title: A panicking test fixture destructor during unwinding aborts the whole test process and loses the run's other results
outcome: One failing test using this fixture reports as one failure; the rest of the run's results survive.
acceptance: The fixture destructor in src/tests/engram_unadmitted_runtime_reporting.rs near lines 213-219 doesn't panic while the thread is already panicking, a regression test shows a failing fixture test doesn't abort its process, and other fixtures with the same pattern are checked and listed

completion.summary: The fixture barriers no longer panic during unwinding, so one failing test reports as one failure and the run's other results survive. On master 7f8d1b63, gated by test-78f5f61f. Judging the remaining Drop impls is w-203dee9a8cb2.
